scope: Coverage diagnosis after failed frozen pilot; not a new successful method claim
architecture: Keep the existing 49,264-parameter model, frozen backbones, same input/association interface; no head/layer additions
selection: Keep previous training/development collection logs. Metadata-only farthest-in-time selection adds one scene per training log and two per development log. Previously inspected holdout logs are excluded. Four fresh head-level test logs are preselected without opening annotations.
first_stage: Extract only the eight added development scenes with the original frozen extractor. Audit fixed seed-0 current/temporal heads. No new training or test evaluation before coverage diagnosis.
opportunity_diagnostic: Using only past records actually retrieved by the frozen association, count current foreground errors for which at least one same-GT-instance historical observation has a correct class prediction from the frozen single-frame head. GT filters/counts evidence only after prediction; this is a privileged availability diagnostic, not deployable accuracy.
if_gate_passes: Extract only the 16 added training scenes; retrain the SAME matched pair with the SAME schedule and three seeds. Require the original advancement gates on expanded development before unsealing a new holdout. No gain may be attributed to memory relative to raw alone.
if_gate_fails: Do not launch more training. Investigate perception/association coverage and where historical evidence is actually available.
reporting: Old failure remains failure. New development is not blind evidence. New holdout is head-level only because the backbone saw official nuScenes training data. No default deployment before semantic, identity and online gates pass.
